root_contract.statement: 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness Millennium problem

actual_fibre.problem_signature: For a nontrivial whole-space 3D incompressible mild bounded ancient Navier-Stokes solution with finite Albritton-Barker I=A+C+D+E, determine whether ancient mildness plus global boundedness yields a uniform-in-time pointwise vorticity/derivative bound, and whether that local bound plus finite I can produce a uniform global weak-L^{3/2} vorticity bound without extra tail/multiplicity/frequency structure.
producer: mild bounded ancient NSE on R^3 x (-infinity,0)
separate_gluing_coordinates: local derivative smoothing versus global spatial tail/multiplicity
finite-I local scale-critical ledger versus whole-space Lorentz norm
pressure/far-field terms kept separate from local smoothing

analogues_and_disanalogies.analogue: critical-element/profile compactness in a globally controlled critical state space
analogues_and_disanalogies.shared_structure: separate local compactness from global orbit/tail compactness
analogues_and_disanalogies.disanalogy: finite Albritton-Barker I is local/scale-critical and does not itself supply a global critical state space
analogues_and_disanalogies.validation: any global Lorentz conclusion must remove all observation-radius/tail dependence

analogues_and_disanalogies.shared_structure: history can remove temporal-edge derivative spikes
analogues_and_disanalogies.disanalogy: every fixed finite history length is dilation-normalizable and is not genuine ancientness
analogues_and_disanalogies.validation: restart must be licensed at arbitrary intermediate ancient times

analogues_and_disanalogies.shared_structure: global weak-L^{3/2} vorticity is one consumer coordinate
analogues_and_disanalogies.disanalogy: consumer also needs critical-profile morphology and log-weighted BMO direction
analogues_and_disanalogies.validation: no amplitude-only result may be promoted to the full consumer interface

decision_policy: Counterexample-first after source-valid local smoothing: if the only route from pointwise vorticity plus finite I to global weak-L^{3/2} retains an observation-radius factor or admits arbitrary separated-packet multiplicity, classify the global step as local-to-global gluing failure rather than iterate stronger local estimates.
falsifiers: If the ancient mild definition does not license restart from arbitrary intermediate times, fail the local smoothing interface.
If derivative constants cannot be made uniform in time from fixed restart depth depending only on M, fail the uniform smoothing claim.
If global Lorentz estimates retain radius or tail dependence, fail the global critical-amplitude claim.
If a multiplicity construction is only a non-solution model, scope it to representation failure and do not refute NSE+finite-I.
If consumer morphology/direction inputs remain unproduced, do not claim the Grujic-v2 endgame is licensed.
